verdict.rationale: Kino documents that cloud agents install the Kino app on their own computers, and that the desktop app runs an MCP server. Neither is a documented skill package or a non-interactive, promptless install path a coding agent can run headlessly end to end. These are adjacent features, so they earn no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my coding agent can install a skill by itself — a non-interactive, promptless install path an agent can run headlessly end to end
